name: Jülide Kahkeci
role: POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCH FELLOW · UNIVERSITY OF ALBERTA
subtitle: PhD in Environmental Engineering
intro: I work at the intersection of photocatalysis, adsorption, and engineered systems for water and wastewater treatment applications. My research focuses on sustainable solutions for the treatment of industrial and municipal effluents, as well as emerging contaminant removal.
about_paragraph_1: I am a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the University of Alberta. I hold a PhD in Environmental Engineering from the University of Alberta, an MSc in Materials Science and Nanotechnology from Bilkent University, and a BSc in Chemical Engineering from Middle East Technical University.
about_paragraph_2: My research interests lie at the intersection of advanced oxidation processes, adsorption, and nature-based solutions for water and wastewater treatment. I work on the development of advanced materials and pilot-scale systems for practical treatment applications.
